name: Girlstuff/Boystuff
description: Girlstuff/Boystuff eavesdrops on six young teens who have been friends forever, three girls - Reanne, Talia and Hannah and three boys - Jason, Simon and Ben. The gang is always there for each other, to keep it real, to tease and to be there for when life sucks.

videos.title: Games Peeps Play / Tent's Situation
videos.overview: When the gang spends a day at the arcade, they meet crushes, get hit on, strike out and win a couple of digits.  The boys and girls compete to see who can outlast the others when they go camping in Talia's backyard.

videos.title: Face Powder Blues / Tickets Please
videos.overview: The boys set out to be rock stars while the girls give Talia a make-over. 411 Boyformation,  THE hottest boy band is in town, and Hanna MUST get tickets.

videos.title: Secrets & Lies / Mall's Fair
videos.overview: Hanna stirs up trouble when she reveals school secrets and invents lies to make her stories more interesting. While Simon struggles through being mistreated at work, Talia stresses about her stolen scarf!

videos.title: Birthday Party / Save Me
videos.overview: Ben suspects his friends are ditching him when they plan a surprise birthday party for him.  Reanne's enlisted the gang's help for a Save the Environment Day - not everyone is there to work however.

videos.title: The Art of You / Flu Manchu
videos.overview: What begins as an innocent trip to the museum turns into quite the adventure. It's a feud between Talia and Jason as they are stuck at home with the flu.

videos.title: Breaking Up Is Hard to Do / Lip Gloss Queen
videos.overview: Jason uses the avoidance tactic to break up with a girl that he is dating and Talia forces him to handle the situation more sensitively.  Vapid Cosmetics announces a contest. Hanna MUST win!

videos.title: Party of the Year / Babysitting Miss Dot
videos.overview: The gang is psyched about going to THE party of the year, or so they thought it would be.  Ben finally has a date but he has forgotten that he has to baby-sit his kid sister. What should he do?

videos.title: Skaterchick / Blind Date
videos.overview: Reanne has to decide between her cool skater friends and Talia and Hanna. Ben gets noticed by a modeling agency.  The gang organizes blind dates for both Jason and Talia and realize pretty fast that it is not going to work. But what to do?

videos.title: Truth or Dare / Multiplex
videos.overview: The gang initiates a game of Truth or Dare in hopes that Hanna will reveal a secret she's been keeping.  The gang heads to the Multiplex theatre to catch a hot new sold out flick but Hanna discovers she can't find her ticket..."No ticket. No movie!"

videos.title: The In Crowd / Gorilla My Dreams
videos.overview: The gang worries when Talia starts to spend more time with a new click at school and tries to become one of them.  Hanna discovers to her horror that Talia and Reanne are not shaving their legs! Simon tries out for the football team.

videos.title: Good Morning Rover / The Incredible Geeks
videos.overview: The dog walking business turns out to be less than a piece of cake when the gang has to deal with everything from runaway dogs to unhappy owners.  Simon drags the gang to a comic convention that is in town to help him pitch his own comic book idea. He is out of luck though when he and Talia get locked out.

videos.title: Discount Fever / Citizen Cane
videos.overview: Ben and Hanna have a bet as to who can stay away from the malls the longest. The gang quickly discovers that old people are anything but boring!

videos.title: The Valentine Curse / Assess This
videos.overview: Valentine's day is around the corner! School candy grams and dates for the big day is all that is on our gang's minds. The gang is quite surprised by the results of a skills assessment test.

videos.title: Cha-Ching / Slam
videos.overview: When Simon gets a credit card mailed to him that has a $1000 limit, he and Hanna think they've hit pay dirt! Talia struggles with stage fright when she has to read her poem aloud at a poetry slam being held at the local coffee house.

videos.title: Listen to the Music / Cram Session
videos.overview: Jason tries to get his own DJ demo tape into his idol's hands. The gang is congregating for an all-night cram session -- however not everyone is there to study.

videos.title: Presently Surprised / Bad Memories
videos.overview: It's Talia's birthday and she is dreading Jason's gift. Reanne and Hanna try to stop Jason before he gives again! The gang starts to reminisce about how they became friends leading to a long flashback to the first days of nursery school. when nobody liked each other!

videos.title: The Making Of... / The Afternoon Snack Club
videos.overview: The gang accidentally deletes Talia's new film project but they have a back up plan! The whole gang gets detention. There, it's their very own Breakfast Club.

videos.title: The Perfect Match / Selling Out
videos.overview: Ben starts a "dating service". Talia tries to get Colin to ask her to the Spring dance. A contest turns the friends into fierce capitalists -- everyone is trying to outwit, outlast, and outplay each other.

videos.title: The Lake / Klingon Someone Else
videos.overview: What was supposed to be a casual afternoon at the Lake turns into a bit of a life lesson. Simon drags the gang to a Sci Fi convention. Hanna gets mistaken for an actress and relishes in the attention.

videos.title: The Young and the Foolish / Cause and Effects
videos.overview: Talia is desperate to meet her favorite soap star at the mall. Reanne and Hanna have a falling out while Simon hooks up with his crush.

videos.title: The Big Switch / Foreign Bodies
videos.overview: Suddenly each member of the group takes on another's identity and chaos breaks out! Things turn sour when Talia thinks Olga (a foreign exchange student staying with them) is trying to take over her crush and her friends!

videos.title: Drama Queen / Mother's Day
videos.overview: Talia is directing her own play, and gets carried away with her Broadway-esque aspirations. The guys are desperate to find Mother's Day presents. They seek the girls help.

videos.title: The Art of the Deal / Un-Amusement Park
videos.overview: Talia desperately tries to impress Colin by tracking down a rare comic he's been looking for. She tries to get Ben to part with his edition but it'll cost her! Haunted houses, Freak Episodes, and Roller-coasters keep the gang on their toes!

videos.title: Video Return / Stuff-A-Palooza
videos.overview: Talia tries desperately to retrieve an embarrassing video tape from the boys. It's the Girl Stuff versus the Boy Stuff; a battle of the bands live at Dells Park.

videos.title: Promises, Promises / Ghoulstuff Boilstuff
videos.overview: Each member of the gang finds themselves living up to past promises.  It's Halloween. Simon and Jason are rigging up a robot to give out candy while the girls are already regretting their decision to go out trick or treating one last time.

videos.title: Weekend Rental / Last Minute Shopping
videos.overview: It's movie night but our gang can't agree on anything to watch.  It's Christmas! The gang scrambles to find presents for each other. The boys head to the gas station to buy while the girls go for the heartfelt home made presents.
